title: Card B — wife dizzy, sees double, 'just tired'

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 530 Ulloa Street. It's my wife. She's dizzy and she keeps bumping into the wall, and she says she sees double. I think she's just tired.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was she last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She was fine about half an hour ago, when we finished dinner.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Ask her to smile for you. Is one side of her face drooping or uneven?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, her face looks normal. She's just wobbly, she can't walk straight.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Can she lift both arms and keep them up?

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Does she take any blood thinners?
